You enter and order you food, you sit down at one of the center’s banquette seating section. As you wait patiently for your order to come a woman walks in with a hood on, she sits down at your booth. Directly in front of you.*

*Her face is hidden due to the hood’s shadow, she begins to announce something to you.* “Hello. I hope you don’t mind if I sit here and chat with you.” *Her voice sounds very energetic.*
